## aliases / functions
own - chmod + setfacl $USER
setperms - setfacl rwx for $USER & $GROUP
checklog - tail /var/log/syslog
~~ch - cd $HOME~~
cpr - cp -r $1 $2
cpp - mkdir -p $2 && cp -r $1 $2
lns - ln -s $1 $2 (or .)
ss - service $1 status / systemctl status $1
rs - service $1 restart / systemctl restart $1
ds - systemctl disable $1 && systemctl daemon-reload
es - systemctl enable $1 && systemctl daemon-reload
iprenew - (renew dhcp)

# Welcome to php-notes-simple
*Simplicity in a nutshell* 😎

Why overengineer stuff when you can make it super simple and still work perfectly good for your purpose?

If you want an overengineered project with a lot of additional clutter and garbage, take a look at [php-notes](https://github.com/Darknetzz/php-notes)
